adoption_decisions.basis: No isolated portable SIMD production candidate with equal-resource end-to-end evidence; conversion-inclusive typed filter is 1.587x slower on its tested input. This does not falsify all SIMD designs.
adoption_decisions.reopen_when: A selected kernel remains significant after storage/validation costs; portable scalar fallback and mixed-type/NULL semantics pass; whole-query gain and protection gates pass.

adoption_decisions.basis: The registered baseline is single CPU and single query thread. Four-client conflict correctness is not parallel operator evidence; adding threads is not an equal-resource speedup.
adoption_decisions.reopen_when: Separate scheduling design with bounded task-local state, shared account, cancellation, deterministic merge/output and equal CPU/thread controls.

adoption_decisions.basis: Existing LZ4/Zstd build support is unchanged. No additional codec/layout candidate has a complete decode, update, point-read, memory and space comparison.
adoption_decisions.reopen_when: Measured representative and holdout tradeoffs, explicit file-version/lifecycle protocol and regression protection.

adoption_decisions.basis: Current Release compile entry uses -O3 -DNDEBUG without LTO or profile-use flags. No separately trained profile and untuned holdout comparison justifies changing the toolchain.
adoption_decisions.reopen_when: Freeze training/holdout manifests, compiler/linker identity, startup/code size and whole-query/resource comparisons before adoption.

adoption_decisions.basis: CPU collector clocks disagree with OS time; no precise expression CPU share is established. No demonstrated benefit covers compile/first-run/cache-hit/code-memory costs. LLVM is not added.
adoption_decisions.reopen_when: First establish expression share and non-JIT baseline, then bounded code-cache ownership, invalidation by plan/schema/type identity, cancellation/failure fallback and portable non-JIT/WASM execution.

selection_amendment: Only requested five-item selection changes; fixed34, mandatory A1-A6 and S5.5 criteria unchanged.
